note: Built as ballot/lean/mn_endorsements.json is, and it holds no records, because no Iowa party page read endorses anyone for November. Iowa's Democratic and Republican parties choose their candidates in the June 2 primary (or by convention where the primary settled nothing), and afterwards their pages list their nominees; no page read uses the word 'endorse', 'supported' or 'recommended' for a candidate in a 2026 state or local race, so there is nothing under endorsements or other_support. A bare list of a party's nominees is not collected: it adds nothing to the party label already on the ballot. No party page named a candidate for a nonpartisan office (township, soil and water, hospital, extension council) or a candidate outside its own party. Only Democratic and Republican candidates (and candidates with no party) are on the state and local lists loaded. Read on 2026-10-02 with the kit's honest User-Agent, each site's robots.txt checked first: the state parties' sites, and every county unit's own website linked from the two state parties' directories (home page plus its candidate, election and news pages, ten pages a site at most; every page was searched for the word, not read line by line). 'lists' is empty because no page carried an endorsement; 'not_read' names the pages looked at and why nothing was taken, and the units that could not or should not be read. Federal offices are outside this file.
